title: Vendor Change Action Schema
description: Schema for updating an existing Vendor record. Only the primary key fields and the properties to be changed should be included.

Company_Code.description: Company Code. Valid Company in Spectrum. Defaults from the Authorization ID if not populated.

Alpha_Sort.description: Vendor Alpha Reference. No commas allowed.

Phone.description: Phone Number. Remove dashes when sending to Spectrum.

Fax_Phone.description: Fax Number. Remove dashes when sending to Spectrum.

Vendor_Email.description: Vendor Email. Must be the basic layout for an email address.

Routing_Limit.description: Routing Limit Invoice Approval. Positive numbers only.

Routing_Code2.description: Routing Code for Over Limit Invoice Approval

Terms_Code.description: Payment due terms. Enter 'A' if based on invoice date. Enter 'B' if based on 1st of next month.

Terms_Days.description: Days Payment Due. Positive numbers only.

Terms_Disc_Code.description: Discount Due (A or B only). Enter 'A' if based on invoice date. Enter 'B' if based on 1st of next month.

Terms_Disc_Days.description: Days Discount Due. Positive numbers only.

Terms_Disc_Percent.description: Discount %. Enter 10.25% as 10.25. Positive numbers only.

Insurance_Exp_Date.description: Ins Expiration Date. Enter as: MM/DD/CCYY (for example, 01/05/2027).

PO_Method.description: Purchase Order Default? 1 = One Step Receiving, 2 = Two Step Receiving.

Vendor_Status.description: Payment method. (P)rint Check, (S)end electronic pre-note, (E)lectronic payment, (C)omdata, or (V) ePayments.

Bank_Account_Code.description: Credit Card account code. Cash Management Credit Card account code

Alt_1099_Name.description: Alternate name. No commas. Used for United States 1099.

Fed_1099_Indicator.description: 1099 Pmt Indicator. 1; 2; 3; 4; 5; 6; 7; 8; 9 or A only (7 for non-employee compensation box). Used for United States 1099. Defaults to 7 if blank and the Send_1099_Flag = Y

Social_Sec_Number.description: Social Security #. Format = 123-45-6789 or 123456789. If defined then Fed_Id_Number must be blank. Used for United States 1099.**

Fed_Id_Number.description: Federal ID #. If defined then Social_Soc_Number must be blank. Used for United States 1099.

Recipient_Type_Code.description: Recipient type. (1) - Individual, (3) - Corporation or (4) - Partnership only. Used for Canadian T5018.

Social_Insurance_Number.description: Social insurance #. If defined then Recipient_Account_Number must be blank. No dashes. Must be 9 characters. Used for Canadian T5018.

Recipient_Account_Number.description: Recipient account #. If defined then Social_Insurance_Number must be blank. No dashes. Must be 15 characters. Used for Canadian T5018.

Partnership_Filer_ID_Number.description: Partnership filer #. Required when Recipient type = 4. Used for Canadian T5018.

Alternate_T5018_Name.description: Alternate Name. Not available when Recipient type = 1. Used for Canadian T5018.

Individual_First_Name.description: First name. Required when Recipient type = 1. Used for Canadian T5018.

Individual_Middle_Initial.description: Middle initial. Available when Recipient type = 1. Used for Canadian T5018.

Individual_Last_Name.description: Last name. Required when Recipient type = 1. Used for Canadian T5018.

Override_Currency_Code.description: Override Currency Code. Multi-Currency module must be active. Currency Code
